note: Replayed by every wrapper (docs/standards/TESTING.md). Indices are -1 for QVP_NONE, in inputs and in answers. A null answer is a call that returns 0. Marks are names from qvp_mark_name. Colours are RGBA numbers. Boxes, distances and points are floats within tolerance; every other number is exact. Each case of letters, selections, queries and hits starts from a fresh page: load the fixture's page, attach its layer, attach the words sidecar when words is true, lay out (printed, for selections and queries), then qvp_tick(0). A selection adds its selector with qvp_style_add (layer 0, red, 0 ms), then qvp_tick(0), then reads qvp_colors, qvp_layout_draw_revision and qvp_layout_draw_list over the whole page. A sequence starts from the fixture's page with no layer and makes its calls in order.

letters.name: the letter fixture with the words sidecar: offsets past the qpc text are none
marks out of offset order, a sign at the letter's own offset, a mark with no offset
a body the page stores as a mark

selections.name: a letter, all of it: the ba's piece and its marks
a letter's body and dots: the members at its own offset
a letter's marks: the members at another offset
one letter of a cut path: its piece only, and the path draws as its pieces
a mark with no offset is in the marks part
a part past 2 is a bad selector
a letter past its word selects nothing
a letter of a word past the page selects nothing
a sign at the letter's own offset is body and dots
the marks part: a mark at another offset and a mark with no offset
the first mark in text order: the hamzah sign at offset 0
the second mark in text order: the kasrah at offset 1
the third mark in text order: the mark with no offset, last
a mark past the last selects nothing
the ba's first mark: its dot
a named mark: dot (16)
a named mark: fathah (1)
a named mark the letter does not have: kasrah (2)
mark id 0 selects nothing
an unnamed mark id (36) acts as unknown (255)
an unnamed mark id (254) acts as unknown (255)
unknown (255): the fixture has no such mark
a named mark that is a mark member: omitted_alif (12)
a named mark that is the letter's body, stored as a mark
a body stored as a mark is body and dots
a letter's offset: the same paths as its body and dots
a mark's own offset: the fathah at 1
a more_at offset: the kashida at 1 is the lam's body
a word-level mark by its offset: the waqf sign at 3
a range of a word: the lam, the ha and the waqf sign
a mark with no offset is never in a range
every character of a cut path: the path is taken whole
from > to is a bad selector
offsets past the text select nothing
an offset past 0xfffe counts as 0xfffe
the sidecar's text: offsets past it select nothing
the sidecar's text: a character no path draws selects nothing
the sidecar's text: an offset inside it still selects
the sidecar's text: a letter keeps its index
a letter's offset in the variant: the body and the hamzah sign
PATH on a cut path reaches its pieces
WORD reaches the pieces, and the path draws whole

queries.name: text 0 and mark 0: every letter of a word
a words scope with a repeat and a word past the page
the body-and-dots part of every letter
the marks part of every letter
a text and a part: the marks of the waw with hamzah
an unnamed mark id (36) acts as unknown (255)
a part past 2 is a bad query
a text that is no code point is a bad query
a surrogate is a bad query

hits.name: on a piece: the ba
on a piece: the lam
on the lam's piece past its word's box
on an uncut body
on a dot: a mark member at the letter's own offset
on a mark at its own offset
on a mark with no offset
on a word-level mark: no letter
between words: the nearest letter of the word hit test's word
in a letter's box, off its ink: a near hit at distance 0
max_distance limits the distance to the word
a miss: no word within max_distance
the sidecar: on a body past the text, at is none
the sidecar: on a word-level mark past the text, at is none
the sidecar: a near hit reports its letter's at, none
a seam: the nearest piece, the ba's
a seam: the nearest piece, the lam's
overlapping marks over a body: the one drawn last
a mark of one letter over another letter's body: the mark
a body under no mark
a counter under another word's box names its own letter
ink wins over the gap split
off ink and out of a counter, the gap split decides
a body stored as a mark: is_body, and its mark
a decoration is no letter
printed view: on the ba's piece
printed view: on a word-level mark
printed view: on the waw of line 2
reflowed view: on the ba's piece
reflowed view: on the lam's piece
reflowed view: on a word-level mark
reflowed view: on the waw of line 2
reflowed view: a seam
printed view: a decoration is no letter

sequences.name: every letter call answers nothing before an attach, and a rule added then waits for the layer
a refused attach changes nothing, an attach appends the pieces, a second attach replaces the first
a words sidecar attached before the layer checks its offsets
a letter colour draws the pieces, a word colour draws the path whole
the pieces stay until the fade ends
every letter of a cut path in one colour draws it whole, in that colour
a theme, a word highlight and a mask never swap by themselves
with a layer, the draw list and the draw revision apply a pending rule
with no layer, a draw-list read leaves a pending fade alone
a swap under a reflow keeps the word's placement
a second attach keeps the rules, and a query takes the new layer
